profile.reading: This is Altia Consultores primary data center in Vigo, Galicia, in northwestern Spain, spanning about 2,500 square meters of the companys own facility space and forming the flagship of a four data center network Altia operates across its Spanish sites, all interconnected with one another. Altia is a technology services company with more than 10 years of experience managing hybrid cloud systems, serving clients across banking, energy, retail, healthcare, and public sector markets, including named customers such as Abanca and Vodafone. The Vigo data center supports managed cloud, private cloud, and SAP HANA Cloud deployments, remote backup and disaster recovery as a service, internet transit, VPN and perimeter security with denial of service protection, and 24/7 systems monitoring, backed by service level agreement guarantees. Altia holds SAP Certified Partner status for both hosting services and cloud and infrastructure services, alongside additional quality and security certifications it lists separately. Altia itself was founded as Altia Consultores S.L. on March 17, 1994 in A Coruna, later relocating its headquarters to Calle Vulcano 3 in the Icaria industrial park in Oleiros in June 2016. The company listed on Spains Mercado Alternativo Bursatil, now BME Growth, on December 1, 2010, and is currently a member of the IBEX MAB 15 index. Altia employs more than 3,200 professionals across more than 20 locations in seven countries, including Spain, the United States, Brazil, Chile, Ireland, the Netherlands, and Portugal, and provides strategic and technology consulting alongside application development, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud and data center services. Altias four site Spanish data center network is designed so the Vigo facility can fail over to or share load with the companys other locations, part of the disaster recovery as a service offering it markets to its banking, energy, retail, healthcare, and public sector clients.
